INCREDIBLE FOOTAGE! See how ball swings in match at heart of Cameron Bancroft sandpaper claims
Wednesday 18 November 2026 14:46, UK
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Cameron Bancroft alleges that Australia were using sandpaper when they took 4-28 in the second Test against South Africa in 2018 and footage appears to support this claim.
England's tour of South Africa is live on Sky Sports from December 17.
